task: Compare existing human grammatical writing rules with readable complete teaching statements, while retaining later physical and source-domain stops. No native or source count and no decoder.
selection: No new complete22-sign writer or experiment selected. Two genuinely different content-bearing word-formation modules have useful demonstrated properties, but neither their unchanged physical promises nor an unregistered union warrants a new hand/statistical trial. No duplicate RAW card is added. This bounded result is not exhaustion of the wider reserve.

retained_modules.human_purpose: Learn an ordinary unary property and a few productive constructions distinguishing being in that state, actually entering it, and an explicitly named participant causing that transition. The affixes carry real distinctions rather than arbitrary alternative spellings.
retained_modules.hand_rule: Write the named participant(s) and one learned predicate root. The unchanged root asserts the state; ~be asserts actual transition from not-P to P; ~ca introduces a first cause participant and a second affected participant. ~anti changes the property to its complement before derivation; final ~not negates the complete assertion. Explicit periods and quoted names are part of the teaching text.
retained_modules.readback_without_original: The claim that Mara causes the individual named Krug A actually to change from not-warm to warm is denied. The notation does not assert that the jug is cold, that it never becomes warm, or that no other cause acts.
retained_modules.contrast_readback: Mara causes that named jug actually to change from warm to not-warm. This is a positive causal assertion concerning a negative property, not the preceding denial.
retained_modules.positive_already_checked: Root's existing full manual review read these distinctions coherently for warm and empty and a separately spelled unfamiliar name. A further example of the same contrast would not change its selection status.
retained_modules.learning_and_writing_cost: Each open property still costs an understood lexical meaning and entity domain. Derivation costs the learned transition/causal semantics, changed arity, fixed participant order, polarity scope, full name spelling, punctuation and quotation. The notation is not a universal29-root reduction.
retained_modules.boundary_of_capability: No command, arbitrary relation, temporal narrative, general disjunction or quantified alternative is automatically licensed. There is no paid22-sign rendering of all lexical/control/name/line-continuation material. These are declared limits, not a newly discovered research gap.
retained_modules.smallest_relevant_counterdifference: A state can hold without a transition, and a transition can occur without the named cause. A writer that merges these cases, or merges outer ~not with inner ~anti, loses supplied content. No native form is assigned to any of these cases.
retained_modules.selection_effect: Retain as a positive source-side derivation rule. Do not order a second abstract readback, new root list or glyph fitting from the unchanged module.

retained_modules.human_purpose: Save a repeated participant expression while explicitly specifying which participant of the preceding clause is reused. This is reference transmission, not number agreement or a permanent record topic.
retained_modules.hand_rule: A finite predicate ends in ~s to reuse its first participant, ~o to reuse its explicitly written second participant, or ~e to end the chain. The next clause omits only that selected first participant and writes any required second one. Learned unary/binary valency fixes the NP count. ! negates the predicate; nominal introductions remain existentially asserted outside that negation.
retained_modules.paid_teaching_lexicon: fol introduces a leaf, tat is the ordered relation touches(S,O), nar is cold(S). These are explicitly invented teaching-language entries, not native word meanings. In a quoted name, the underscore recovers an ordinary space.
retained_modules.readback_without_original: There exists a leaf that the individual literally named Tava Ada does not touch, and that same leaf is cold. The sentence does not deny that any leaf exists, assert a prohibition, or change the carried object by proximity.

minimal_reference_pair.readback: A leaf touches a vessel; the same leaf is cold.
A leaf touches a vessel; the same vessel is cold.

retained_modules.complete_teaching_boundaries: Quotes protect names, tilde marks finite morphology, visible spaces separate groups, and ~e explicitly closes a chain. Ordinary line breaks do not reset the reference. The Roman lesson has a paid backslash continuation convention whose reassembly precedes quote parsing; this is not yet a22-sign carrier.
retained_modules.learning_and_memory_cost: Learn each predicate/kind and valency, three reference endings, restricted negation scope and the quoted-name/continuation rules. Retain only the selected participant between clauses. An old unnamed participant lost from that slot cannot be recovered by an unspoken return.
retained_modules.strongest_existing_countercase: The raw card itself proves that any legal adjacent triple of identical complete teaching groups must be a unary predicate with SAME continuation. Under a fixed injective whole-group rendering and one invariant nonempty word-final SAME exponent, every such triple must share the exponent's final sign. The previously supplied distinct-terminal triple obligations contradict that narrow carrier realization. No new data are queried and no varied suffix or extra grammar class is added to evade it.
retained_modules.prior_boundaries: 569/592/596 already treated editorial argument carry, and952 already treated explicit number agreement. Their supplied meanings/defaults do not establish this module's written controller.957 is a distinct abstract grammar, but its imported-unreviewed registry status does not erase its already written counterargument.
retained_modules.selection_effect: Retain the explicit reference contrast; do not nominate the known uniform-final carrier or a repeated triple census.

joint_interface_check_without_building_a.different_useful_properties: 953 derives a new predicate and changes its valency/content;957 propagates one of a predicate's already specified participants into the next clause. They solve different writing tasks.
joint_interface_check_without_building_a.not_free_composition: A causal953 form has a cause and affected participant, while a state/change form has one participant.957's ~o is defined only for a genuinely present second argument. Attaching an object-carry ending to a unary state would invent a participant. Similarly,953 event/transition content is not silently supplied by957's atemporal assertion order.
joint_interface_check_without_building_a.concrete_alternative_obligation: For a stated leaf x touching a stated vessel y, the additional content cold(x) OR cold(y) is not the same as cold(x), cold(y), or both. The s/o pair selects one reference; it does not express a written alternative.957 has no disjunction production. A reader may not choose whichever continuation is plausible and claim the alternative preserved.
joint_interface_check_without_building_a.scope_of_this_check: This is a conceptual interface comparison of the existing contracts, not a new combined grammar, new letter table, historical-source encoding or native counterexample. The complete Roman examples establish limited human readability, not complete historical source coverage or statistical fit.
joint_interface_check_without_building_a.decision_changed: Do not count the two separate readability positives as a complete combined writer. A proposed union must explicitly specify the changed valency and alternative/scope signals before it could be selected; that work is not silently performed here.
